operationalLimits.simulatorUse: read-only screenshots only when explicitly requested

protection.R420: same R436 app/data paths, exact app inventory and installed executable; starting primary save must be rev75 / exact SHA.
protection.R436: The 14 historical protected trees remain exact, except if the exact R437 data-container path is present in that list; that one path is tracked exclusively by the fresh post-R441 R437 data baseline. The R420 app inventory remains pinned separately.
protection.R437: installed app compared to pinned build appFiles; data checked against Root-sealed post-R441 inventory every command; process must remain absent.

requiredRootBaseline.canonicalInventoryDigest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), then one LF; map keys are relative paths and each row contains sha256,sizeBytes,mode.
requiredRootBaseline.failureBehavior: HOLD before execution_r001 creation if absent/stale/unsealed, if R437 is running, or if live data differs.

requiredFields.r437AppPath: exact app path from pinned R437 install receipt
requiredFields.r437DataInventory: relative-path to {sha256,sizeBytes,mode} map after R441 closeout
requiredFields.r437DataInventorySHA256: canonical JSON digest of inventory: UTF-8 sorted keys, compact separators, final LF
requiredFields.r437DataPath: exact data path from pinned R437 install receipt
requiredFields.r441CloseoutSHA256: SHA-256 of the sealed R441 CLOSURE.json

resultBoundary: Late closure allowed. Preservation status is independent of wall/evidence caps; fields record whether each cap was met. Unattempted bosses or research must remain NOT_REACHED; helper does not infer gameplay completion.
scope: Root-operated ordinary progression from exact R436 revision 75. Root alone performs game UI and app lifecycle. Helper only snapshots support files and takes optional screenshots.
